import json, subprocess, sys, os, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import ref, main as submain
BIN = pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('TMPDIR','/workspace/tmp'))/'unit-merge-build'/'engine'

BASE = {"topology":["leaf-spine",3,2],"caps":[9,9,9,0,0],"groups":[[1,10],[1,10]],
        "tasks":[[0,0,3,7,1],[1,0,4,7,1]],
        "query":{"groups":[0,1],"nodes":[0,1,2],"tasks":[0,1]},"transactions":[]}

def run(edits, tasks=None, rev=0):
    s = json.loads(json.dumps(BASE))
    if tasks: s['tasks'] = tasks
    s['transactions'] = [{"revision":rev,"edits":edits,
                          "query":{"groups":[0,1],"nodes":[0,1,2],"tasks":[0,1]}}]
    req = {"version":2,"sessions":[s]}
    exp = ref.run(req)
    data = submain.transport(req)
    r = subprocess.run([str(BIN)], input=data, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    got = json.loads(r.stdout.decode())
    same = json.dumps(got,sort_keys=True)==json.dumps(exp,sort_keys=True)
    tx = exp['sessions'][0]['transactions'][0] if 'sessions' in exp else None
    return same, (tx['violations'] if tx else None), (tx['accepted'] if tx else None), got, exp

CASES = [
    ("move+quota of old group", [["move",0,1],["quota",0,2]], [0,0,0,2], False),
    ("quota changed and back", [["quota",0,2],["quota",0,1]], [0,0,0,0], True),
    ("unpin then move", [["pin",0,0],["move",0,1]], [0,0,0,1], False),
    ("pin then move (new pin)", [["pin",0,1],["move",0,1]], [0,0,0,0], True),
    ("budget change only", [["budget",0,5]], [0,0,0,0], True),
    ("cap change only", [["cap",0,3]], [0,0,0,0], True),
    ("weight change on pinned", [["weight",0,5]], [0,0,0,1], False),
    ("class change on pinned", [["class",0,8]], [0,1,0,1], False),
    ("bind change on pinned", [["bind",0,2]], [0,0,0,1], False),
    ("move away and back", [["move",0,1],["move",0,0]], [0,0,0,0], True),
    ("move away and back + quota", [["move",0,1],["move",0,0],["quota",0,2]], [0,0,0,2], False),
    ("unpinned task quota", [["quota",0,2]], [0,0,0,2], False),
]
unpinned = [[0,0,3,7,0],[1,0,4,7,0]]
CASES2 = [
    ("unpinned: move+quota", [["move",0,1],["quota",0,2]], [0,0,0,0], True, unpinned),
    ("unpinned: quota", [["quota",0,2]], [0,0,0,0], True, unpinned),
]
allok = True
for c in CASES:
    name, edits, eviol, eacc = c
    same, viol, acc, got, exp = run(edits)
    ok = same and viol == eviol and acc == eacc
    allok &= ok
    print(('OK  ' if ok else 'FAIL'), name, 'viol', viol, 'acc', acc, 'ref-match', same)
for name, edits, eviol, eacc, tasks in CASES2:
    same, viol, acc, got, exp = run(edits, tasks=tasks)
    ok = same and viol == eviol and acc == eacc
    allok &= ok
    print(('OK  ' if ok else 'FAIL'), name, 'viol', viol, 'acc', acc, 'ref-match', same)
print('ALL OK' if allok else 'PROBLEMS')
PYEOF
python3 pinsanity.py
